items.title: Cisco Patches Firewall Zero-Day Exploited for DoS Attacks
items.description: CVE-2026-20349 can be exploited remotely without authentication against Secure Firewall ASA and FTD devices. The post Cisco Patches Firewall Zero-Day Exploited for DoS Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Google says Chrome cuts 7 billion unwanted Android notifications a day to fight abuse
items.description: Google says Chrome's anti-abuse systems reduced unwanted notifications on Android by more than 7 billion per day during the first quarter of 2026. [...]
